title: The Mother and the Wolf
summary: A wolf waited outside a cottage all day because a mother scolded her crying child: "Be quiet, or I will toss you to the wolf!"...
full_text:
A wolf waited outside a cottage all day because a mother scolded her crying child: "Be quiet, or I will toss you to the wolf!"

That evening, the mother rocked the quiet baby, singing: "If the wicked wolf comes, we will strike him with a cudgel!"

The wolf trotted home hungry, murmuring: "They say one thing in anger and do quite another in love!"
moral: Do not rely on the promises of mortals made in moments of anger.
